ordered_diagnoses: Silicone Oil Droplets in Lamellar Macular Hole

s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive vision loss in one eye with history of retinal detachment and choroidal neovascularization
salient_findings: Emulsified silicone oil in the fovea of the left eye
Lamellar macular hole with hyperreflective dots
Vision acuity of 20/200 in the left eye
key_facts: Patient is a man in his early 60s
History of vitrectomy and cataract surgery on the left eye
History of rhegmatogenous retinal detachment in the left eye
Received multiple intravitreous ranibizumab injections for myopic choroidal neovascularization
Best-corrected visual acuity is 20/40 in the right eye
Best-corrected visual acuity is 20/200 in the left eye
Multimodal imaging revealed emulsified silicone oil in the fovea of the left eye
En face imaging with swept source optical coherence tomography demonstrated confinement of the hyperoleon within a lamellar macular hole

shortlist: Silicone Oil Droplets in Lamellar Macular Hole

shortlist.label: Emulsified silicone oil syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Multimodal imaging revealed emulsified silicone oil in the fovea of the left eye

shortlist.label: Myopic choroidal neovascularization
shortlist.why_kept: History of myopic choroidal neovascularization and receipt of intravitreous ranibizumab injections

shortlist.label: Lamellar macular hole
shortlist.why_kept: En face imaging with swept source optical coherence tomography demonstrated confinement of the hyperoleon within a lamellar macular hole

shortlist.label: Silicone oil retinopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of emulsified silicone oil in the fovea and history of vitrectomy

shortlist.label: Choroidal neovascularization recurrence
shortlist.why_kept: History of choroidal neovascularization and decreased visual acuity in the left eye

raw.rationale: The presence of emulsified silicone oil in the fovea of the left eye, as revealed by multimodal imaging, and its confinement within a lamellar macular hole, as demonstrated by en face imaging with swept source optical coherence tomography, are key findings that align with Emulsified Silicone Oil Syndrome.

rejected.label: Silicone Oil Droplets in Lamellar Macular Hole
rejected.why: While silicone oil droplets are present within a lamellar macular hole, the syndrome encompasses more than just the presence of oil droplets, and the patient's history and imaging findings better fit the broader diagnosis of Emulsified Silicone Oil Syndrome.
